notes.title: 20220911 Future Update Content
notes.content:
Here is the update direction and content of the future super weapon masters
The higher the content ranking, the higher the priority
The updated content is expected to appear in the next 1 to 2 months
1. Bug fixes for player reactions
2. Optimize the experience and operation of the game according to the opinions and suggestions of players' reactions
3. Optimize the sound effect experience. Reduce the continuous harsh sound experience in the middle and late game
4. Numerical balance adjustment
5. New super weapon
6. New upgrade passive
7. New upgrade enhancement options
8. New monsters with new action modes and different mechanics
9. Added level difficulty selection and related new mechanisms
10. New map
11. Support for handle
12. Achievement system

notes.title: 20220908 Content update
notes.content:
20220908 update content
1 Modify the underlying logic. Optimize resource consumption. Now smoother with a lot of bullets and enemies in the mid to late game
2 Added in-game mouse pointer. Alleviate the situation that the mouse cannot be seen clearly due to too many elements on the screen
3 Fixed the problem that in some cases, the resurrection after the death of the character did not correctly deduct the number of resurrections, resulting in multiple resurrections
4 Added title interface version text display
5 Numerical balance adjustment. Alleviate the situation where the player is too strong in some cases and there is no challenge in the middle and late game
6 Fixed the problem that the monster would be bounced over a long distance in some cases
